content.text: A single, self-contained HTML file (all markup, CSS and JavaScript inline) that works as a tourism landing page for Beirut, Lebanon. It inspires first-time visitors with the city's sights, food, culture and seaside, and leads them to one call-to-action, "Plan your trip". It is bilingual (English and Arabic, with a toggle), looks impressive on phones and desktops, and is built to rank well in search engines.

file with inline CSS and JS; hero, highlights, neighbourhoods, best-time-to-visit, call-to-action and footer sections; English and Arabic content with a language toggle; hotlinked royalty-free photos; on-page SEO metadata and structured data.
OUT: any contact, booking or newsletter form (call-to-action links only); a backend, analytics or cookie banner; separate per-language URLs; a CMS; hosting and domain setup.
None — a single static page with no ordered process beyond reading and clicking.

R1: The deliverable SHALL be one HTML file that loads and renders fully with no local files and no external stylesheet, script, font or framework; the only external resources are the hotlinked photos.

R2: The page SHALL present, in this order: a full-screen hero (headline, tagline, call-to-action button), a highlights section (history, food, culture, seaside), a neighbourhoods section, a best-time-to-visit section, a closing call-to-action, and a footer.

R5: The page SHALL be responsive, with no horizontal scrolling and no overlapping content at viewport widths of 360 px, 768 px and 1280 px.

R9: IF a hotlinked photo fails to load, THEN the page SHALL still show its section legibly, using a CSS gradient background in the photo's place.

R10: The page SHALL be accessible: body text and its background SHALL have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, every interactive element SHALL be reachable and visibly focused by keyboard, and animations SHALL be disabled WHEN the visitor's system requests reduced motion.
None — a static page with no persisted business nouns.
The page is the deliverable itself, specified by R2 to R10; no root bean exists, so the beans are edited through their default forms inside the screens that reach them (there are none).

Design intent: a bold, cinematic hero with a Beirut skyline or Mediterranean photo under a dark overlay; a warm Mediterranean palette (deep sea blue, sandstone, terracotta accent); large type, generous spacing, card grids with soft hover effects, smooth scrolling and gentle scroll-reveal animation; a sticky header with section links and the language toggle.
None — no other specs or platform entities. The photos are hotlinked from a royalty-free provider (e.g. Unsplash) and are the page's only external dependency.
The file SHALL work in current versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge.
Photos SHALL be royalty-free for commercial use, and the footer SHALL credit the photo provider.
Considered, none apply: authorization, volume, availability, audit, privacy and retention (the page collects no data), cost.
